newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC stocks lower, activity strong.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC stocks lower, activity strong.

text.p: Croatian stocks trading on an over-the-counter stock market lost ground amid stronger activity in the week to July 18, the Varazdin market said on Monday.
The leading seven-stock VIN index ended Friday at 9,752 points, down from 9,904 from the week before as 15 traded issues fell, nine rose and four were flat.
Weekly volume in regular trade almost doubled to 24,905 shares and turnover was also higher at 9.7 million kuna.
A package 62,409 paid, and subscribed but unpaid-for shares in department store Vama from Varazdin, was sold for a turnover of 3.4 million kuna, bringing the total turnover to 13.2 million.
Ericsson Tesla was the most active stock on volume of 17,961 units, adding 2.25 percent to 455 kuna.
Top gainer was Slavonska Banka, up 42.08 percent to 1,300 kuna, with 48 units sold. Top loser cable maker Elka edged down 18.46 percent to 159 kuna, selling 100 shares.
